criterion: 同一支撑脚连续着地，在逐步变化的相对位置上各用两张独立姿态，再与另一脚交替。
sourceMessage: 我说的直脚着地两帧，再旁边点两帧，再旁边点两帧，再旁边点俩帧，依次类推

segments.position: first support foot slightly behind/still bears weight
first support foot rear/late stance and final push
opposite support foot slightly behind/still bears weight
opposite support foot rear/late stance and final push

constraints: Actual independent images at every slot; no duplicate/mirror/warp/interpolation
No whole-sprite shift to fake ground
Positions follow each direction's motion/depth; feet do not fan sideways
Stance remains continuous within each eight-frame half-cycle; free leg recovers and swings
Preserve current upperbody/identity/prop ownership and all correct frames
